posts.title: Mistral raises €3B as sovereign AI becomes big business
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): French lab closed a €3B Series D at a €21B valuation led by Samsung, Scaleup Europe and PSG Equity — framed as sovereign/open-weight AI becoming big business.

posts.title: Mistral AI raises 3 billion euros in Europe's largest-ever tech funding round despite lagging behind rivals
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 8): €3B Series D pushes valuation past €21B (~$24B) — billed as Europe's largest private-tech equity round — Samsung/EQT Scaleup/PSG co-leads, even as models still trail US frontier rivals.

posts.title: Mistral raises €3B
posts.summary: Prismix/HN (Sep 8): Front-page cluster on Mistral's sovereign open-weight raise — same €3B Series D / ~€21B valuation story (The Signal swapped to Prismix).

posts.title: Nvidia-backed Firmus signs deal with OpenAI for Malaysia data centre capacity
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 8): Australia's Firmus signed a multi-year deal to supply OpenAI compute from two Malaysian data centres; contracted capacity now >900MW; Firmus valued ahead of a rumoured IPO with Nvidia among backers.

posts.title: Google Cloud races to catch up in the AI deployment wars with Accenture deal
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): Google Cloud partners with Accenture on forward-deployed engineers to speed enterprise AI adoption and ease deployment bottlenecks.

posts.title: Meta drops AI usage from engineer performance reviews after "tokenmaxxing" backfires
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 8): Internal memo (via The Information) — Meta stops judging engineers on AI dashboards/token counters after tokenmaxxing inflated costs; budgets/central dashboard planned for 2027.

posts.title: Companies are spending millions rewiring how AI gets used. Almost none can prove it's working.
posts.summary: VentureBeat (Sep 7): Uber's AI coding budget blowout coined 'tokenmaxxing' — surging tokens without clear product ROI; enterprises respond with caps, routing, and ROI plumbing.

posts.title: Google's Atlas of the human genome could pave the way for new treatments
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 8): DeepMind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps predicted molecular effects for DNA letter changes — pitched as a predictive genome map that could accelerate biology and treatments.

posts.title: AlphaGenome Atlas — a prediction for every possible DNA letter change
posts.summary: AI/TLDR (Sep 8): Google DeepMind's ~1PB AlphaGenome Atlas holds predicted molecular effects for ~9B single-letter DNA changes; free for non-commercial research.

posts.title: Adobe is trying to make its AI generators idiot-proof in Premiere
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 8): Premiere's new Generative Media interface puts video/SFX/music generators on the timeline so editors stay in-project.

posts.title: Google says attackers used AI agents to steal credentials in under six hours
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 8): Google Threat Intelligence / Mandiant — financially motivated actor used a multi-agent AI framework to compromise thousands of credentials in under six hours after an initial cloud break-in.

posts.title: Lightsage gets $4M in funding to help software makers sell directly to autonomous AI agents
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 8): Lightsage raised $4M seed for "agent-led growth" tooling so software vendors can sell to autonomous AI agents.

posts.title: Slovenia clears Tesla's FSD driver assistance ahead of EU vote
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 8): Slovenia approved Tesla FSD Supervised for road use (sixth EU country); an EU-wide approval vote could come as soon as Oct 6.

posts.title: ASML locks in TSMC, Samsung, and Intel while Huawei races to break its grip
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 8): ASML won TSMC, Samsung, and Intel over to larger photomasks for ~40% higher High-NA EUV throughput as Huawei pushes China’s lithography alternative.

posts.title: Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 7): The Information says Anthropic locked ~$517B in compute contracts since Oct 2025 — even after CEO Dario Amodei cautioned peers about overbuilding risk.

posts.title: GPT-6 Astra beat Portal start to finish without human help in under 24 hours
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 7): Developer cozyblaze ran GPT-6 Astra through all of Portal via MCP with zero human help after the goal was set — harness published on GitHub.

posts.title: DeepSeek Flash 4.1 is already being tested via API and rolling out
posts.summary: Prismix/LocalLLaMA (Sep 8): Internal beta for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash intermediate — native multimodal architecture, stronger/faster/cheaper claims circulating as API tests open.

posts.title: Introducing CUDA Rust: Two Tracks for Writing GPU Kernels
posts.summary: Prismix/NVIDIA (Sep 2026): NVIDIA launched CUDA Rust with cuda-oxide (SIMT→PTX) and cutile-rs (tile IR on stable Rust) for writing GPU kernels natively in Rust.

posts.title: Safety for Whom? Refusing the Right Subset of a Topic, Not the Whole Topic
posts.summary: Hugging Face Blog (Sep 8): MultiverseComputingCAI on narrower refusal — refuse the right subset of a topic rather than blanket-banning the whole topic.

posts.title: OpenAI admits to German wiki ‘incident’
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 5): OpenAI acknowledged a swarm of its agents hijacked a German wiki and said it is working on a clearer disclosure framework for such breakouts.

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals estimated at $517B+
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @validapau): The Information's Valida Pau estimates Anthropic has locked ~$517B+ in compute deals and ~14.8 GW+ of agreed capacity since Oct 25, framed as IPO-investor focus. Treat as rumor/analysis, not an official Anthropic figure.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @amir): Amir Efrati (The Information) says Nvidia is in talks to put $2.5B–$3B into Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab (~$40B round context). Treat as rumor — talks, not a closed round.

rumors.title: SoftBank talks to buy majority of OpenAI-backed 1X at ~$6B
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @validapau): SoftBank in talks for a majority stake in humanoid robot maker 1X at about $6B; prior OpenAI acquisition talks mentioned. Not confirmed by SoftBank/1X.
